turns.query: Our turbidity readings are in NTU but another pod reports FNU — can I compare them?

relevant.evidence:
Turbidity units: NTU (white-light) and FNU (infrared) are not interchangeable. Standardize on
one across the fleet.

The designations NTU, NTRU, BU, AU, and NTMU signify the
use of a broad spectrum incident light in the wavelength range
400-680 nanometers (nm).

raw data from differently designed instruments
should not be considered directly interchangeable
Multiparameter instruments used for most in situ turbidity applications contain single-beam infrared wavelength turbidity sensors and are reported in FNU.
